anchor.snippet: test('native terminals deliver negotiated mouse clicks and wheel scrolling to fullscreen applications', { timeout: 45000 }, async () => {

entries.note: Use a real PTY program with clickable item and application-owned scroll state, driven through native SDL input. Record negotiated SGR and legacy X10 packets to assert cell coordinates, tracking modes, modifiers, horizontal wheel, balanced off-pane/focus/GUI-close releases, old-history suppression and root/focus preservation after pane movement. Read native cell/grid inspection rather than the lagging service state for coordinate targets. Optional RENGINE_MOUSE_REPLAY names an ignored private JSON snapshot of an actual Claude session; replay its escape sequences in this isolated program, reattach, assert historical queries emit no replies, then verify SGR click/wheel packets and live query responses. This does not launch another provider conversation, operate Remote Control or assert live Claude menu outcomes. Static recorded output at a different pane size is protocol evidence, not a faithful resized Claude layout.
